subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: After the two lifecycle defects are repaired, should this provider-backed WeChat reload change require redacted live A+B QR-login evidence, or is focused Gateway lifecycle proof sufficient for this exact head?
rationale: The contributor cannot access a real WeChat provider session, while the reported user outcome depends on provider-backed account enumeration and login refresh timing that unit-level Gateway tests do not fully establish.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real WeChat A+B login/reload run shows account A remains online after account B is added.

options.title: Accept focused Gateway proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider evidence after the two lifecycle races are fixed and the exact merge result passes focused reload coverage.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real WeChat A+B login/reload run shows account A remains online after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged account-aware reload work makes them the strongest available adjacent owner for assessing whether Gateway-level lifecycle proof establishes this contract.
